component.name: Lekhani
component.summary: Modern Pure Rust Bengali Input Method & Desktop Suite

description.p: Lekhani is a modern, ultra-fast, Unicode-compliant Bengali input method framework and desktop suite for Linux. It features Avro Phonetic transliteration, popular fixed keyboard layouts (Probhat, National Jatiya, Munir Optima, Borno, Unijoy), a native Slint UI, Bijoy-to-Unicode conversion, emoji shortcodes, and native Fcitx5 and IBus engines. Special thanks to Avro Keyboard (OmicronLab) and OpenBangla Keyboard for their pioneering contributions.
Lekhani 1.0.0 official release by Syntenieum (2026) with pure Rust core, regression-proof phonetic engine, native Wayland/KDE Fcitx5 addon, and IBus daemon.
